To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PBL is an effective and efficient way to teach biochemistry to medical students.
students learn more effectively and retain more of what they learn when they are taught in a PBL environment than in a lecture environment.
PBL cases are an excellent format to teach biochemistry to medical students and complementing lectures greatly enhance the quality and accuracy of student learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a curriculum that will provide a solid foundation in the basic science and clinical applications of biochemistry for the students of today and tomorrow.
the development and implementation of an innovative biochemistry course for medical students using the problem based learning format.

the development of a biochemistry curriculum that will be effective in teaching and in providing students with a strong foundation for the application of biochemical knowledge to the practice of medicine and the understanding of the molecular basis of human disease.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a biochemistry curriculum should have both PBL and lecture based formats.
the biochemistry curriculum at the University of Rocheser School of Medicine and Denistry is a hybrid of the PBL and lecture based formats.
PBL is the most effective way to teach biochemistry to medical students and that the lecture based curriculum is the best way to teach biochemists to medical students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the PBL cases are a very powerful tool for teaching and learning biochemistry and molecular biology in the medical curriculum and that the lectures complement the PBL cases and provide the opportunity to teach the basic science concepts in a more uniform and accurate way.
the PBL format is a powerful tool in the teaching of biochemistry and the complementary lecture format enhances the learning experience for students.
PBL cases are excellent for the integration of biochemistry into medicine and for teaching students how to learn biochemistry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of PBL with lecture-based formats is the most effective way to teach biochemistry in the medical school curriculum.
the PBL format is not a panacea for all of the ills of medical education.

the integration of biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, and medicine is essential for the education of medical students and that PBL cases can serve as a powerful tool in this integration.
